tx:
It seems that the chances of getting a page increase the higher one's dominion factor gets. An effective way to do this is to do Climber mode and fight to as high of a floor as possible, since the Dominion Factor accumulates very fast in this mode.
Points per round
• Climber mode - 4,000-20,000 points
• Endurance mode - 1,000-15,000 points
• Special mode - 500-3,000 points
Reaching floor 20 in Climber mode will usually yield over 200,000 dominion factor, which usually results in one or two journal pages upon opening the rewards box. However, if the player comes across a boss they do not think they will be able to defeat, it is better to stand and collect the reward than to die fighting the boss, as the Dominion Factor will be greatly reduced upon death.
sc: The player can obtain all the pages from one mode.
